verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm, not a software platform that holds user data, so self-service export of all your data in open formats is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows a client-facing data platform: the legaltech and Prarambh material describes internal AI tools and an incubator, not a hosted service with exportable user data. The one partly related scenario, clients taking their files when they change counsel, is not a product export capability and is not evidenced.
